notes.title: New Language Update – 11 More Languages Now Supported!
notes.content:
Our latest update brings full localization in 11 new languages, making it easier than ever for players around the world to enjoy the game in their native language.

[b]Newly Supported Languages:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Spanish
[*] Hindi
[*] Russian
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Turkish
[*] Indonesian
[*] Portuguese (Portugal)
[/olist]
